design_philosophy: The 'Performance Pro' Archetype. High-contrast, tactical minimalism designed for fast-paced restaurant environments. Emphasizes operational clarity, large touch targets for tablet POS, and dense data visualization for admin. Void Black base with high-visibility Electric Orange and Pure White for immediate action recognition.

typography.font_strategy: The 'Soft Utility' + 'Technical' Blend. Solid, modern headings combined with highly legible data-friendly body text.

primary.description: Electric Orange for primary actions like 'Оплатить' (Pay) and active states. Appetizing but highly visible.

secondary.description: Cyan for information mapping, active table indication, and kitchen sync status.

success.description: Used strictly for successful payments and completed kitchen orders.

visual_enhancers.surface_strategy: Grid Borders (The Technical Look) for Admin Dashboard. Flat Solid with precise 1px strokes for POS buttons. NO glassmorphism in the POS workflow to maintain absolute visual clarity.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Omit soft shadows in POS. Use solid 1px borders or 2px 'Inner Glow' highlights for active items.
visual_enhancers.border_radius: Subtle roundness. `rounded-lg` (8px) for buttons/cards to feel modern but structured. `rounded-xl` (12px) for large layout panels.

admin_dashboard.sidebar: w-64 fixed left-0 top-0 h-full border-r border-[#27272A] bg-[#0A0A0A]
admin_dashboard.grid: Bento Grid Protocol (High Density). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6

pos_tablet.structure: 3-Panel Horizontal Layout (No scrolling on main viewport)
pos_tablet.left_panel: w-[20%] border-r border-[#27272A] flex flex-col h-screen (Categories & Navigation)
pos_tablet.center_panel: w-[50%] p-6 flex flex-col h-screen overflow-y-auto (Product Grid: grid-cols-3 or grid-cols-4 gap-4)
pos_tablet.right_panel: w-[30%] border-l border-[#27272A] bg-[#121212] h-screen flex flex-col (Order Ticket, Actions, Numpad)

login_screen.structure: Split screen or modal overlay over dark atmospheric background

buttons.primary: bg-[#FF5A00] text-white rounded-lg px-6 py-4 font-semibold text-lg hover:bg-[#E04F00] active:scale-95 transition-transform flex items-center justify-center
buttons.pos_item: bg-[#1A1A1A] border border-[#27272A] rounded-lg p-4 flex flex-col items-start gap-2 hover:border-[#FF5A00] active:scale-95 transition-all text-left
buttons.numpad: bg-[#1A1A1A] border border-[#27272A] rounded-lg text-2xl font-medium h-16 flex items-center justify-center hover:bg-[#27272A] active:scale-95 transition-transform

cards.admin_bento: bg-[#121212] border border-[#27272A] rounded-xl p-6 flex flex-col h-full
cards.receipt_ticket: bg-white text-black p-4 text-sm font-mono (Used visually to represent the printed receipt in checkout flow)

motion.interactions: Fast and tactile. Micro-animations on all buttons (`active:scale-95 transition-transform duration-100`).
motion.lists: Staggered fade-in for product grids and order items.
motion.modals: Slide up from bottom for checkout/payment flow in POS.

accessibility.contrast: Strict adherence to high contrast. Text over active states must be pure white or pure black. No low-contrast disabled states (use dashed borders or 40% opacity instead).
accessibility.touch_targets: All tappable elements in POS must be at least 56x56px (min-h-14 min-w-14) to accommodate fast tapping on tablets.

libraries.icons: @phosphor-icons/react (Used for dense, readable UI in both Admin and POS)
libraries.charts: recharts (For Admin Sales, Revenue, Top Items)
libraries.ui_components: shadcn/ui (Heavily customized for Dark mode flat styling. Use Table for inventory, Tabs for workshops/цеха)
libraries.state: zustand (Critical for managing POS cart state globally without prop drilling)

login_background.description: Dimly lit restaurant kitchen featuring a chef at work, creating an intimate atmosphere.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a Dark Mode exclusive POS/ERP interface. Set `bg-[#0A0A0A] text-white` on the root body.
Implement two distinct layouts using React Router: `/admin/*` for the Back-Office and `/pos/*` for the Waiter/Cashier Tablet app.
For the POS interface: NEVER use scrolling on the `body` or `html`. Fix the height to `100vh` and only allow scrolling inside the central Product Grid and the Order Ticket list.
Use standard HTML/Tailwind for the POS layout (raw divs and grids) for maximum control over touch targets and borders, rather than forcing Shadcn Cards everywhere.
Use Shadcn components primarily in the Admin Dashboard (Tables for Warehouse/Inventory, Dialogs for Settings, Select for category mapping, Charts for Reports).
Language is Russian: Use terms like 'Панель управления' (Dashboard), 'Касса' (POS), 'Склад' (Inventory), 'Цеха' (Workshops), 'Сотрудники' (Staff).
Build a PIN Pad component for the POS login/checkout flow. It must look like a physical keypad.
Avoid glassmorphism. Use flat surfaces with crisp 1px borders (`border-[#27272A]`) to separate panes and widgets.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and subtle border colors, not heavy shadows.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., `transition: all`). Use specific transitions like `transition-transform` or `transition-colors`.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in CSS.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡) for icons. Use Phosphor Icons.
Use 2-3x more spacing in the Admin Dashboard, but keep the POS Tablet interface dense enough to avoid unnecessary scrolling.
Use `sonner` for toast notifications (e.g., 'Заказ отправлен на кухню' - Order sent to kitchen).
